title: LocalAIAgentSandboxRequirementsCatalog
description: Exhaustive machine-readable systems engineering catalog of exactly 50 requirements, failure vectors, kernel mechanisms, and static verification assertions for local AI coding agents.

requirements.title: Linux Landlock ABI v1-v3 FS Access & Descriptor Mask Normalization

developer_symptom.description: Agent reads secrets like .env inside allowed project tree because Landlock lacks subtractive deny; passing directory masks to files crashes kernel call with EINVAL.
developer_symptom.impact: Ambient secret leakage or startup failure of the sandbox ruleset.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Additive ruleset with strip_read_on_write and file-mask filtering (stripping directory-only bits like READ_DIR on regular files) with REFER and TRUNCATE ABI support.

requirements.title: Linux Landlock ABI v4 TCP Port Sandboxing

developer_symptom.description: Compromised dependency opens listening backdoor on 0.0.0.0:8080 or connects to cloud metadata 169.254.169.254 without network restrictions.
developer_symptom.impact: Unauthorized lateral network egress or host service exposure.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Ruleset extension to 16 bytes handling LANDLOCK_ACCESS_NET_BIND_TCP (1<<0) and LANDLOCK_ACCESS_NET_CONNECT_TCP (1<<1) with LandlockNetPortAttr structures.

requirements.title: Linux Landlock ABI v5 PTY Ioctl Control & Character Device Whitelist

developer_symptom.description: Interactive CLI agent crashes with EPERM/ENOTTY when executing TIOCSWINSZ resize ioctl on Linux 6.10+ because IOCTL_DEV is active but terminal nodes are unlisted.
developer_symptom.impact: Interactive terminal resize failure and broken CLI TUI rendering.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Handling LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_IOCTL_DEV (1<<15) with explicit addition of /dev/ptmx, /dev/pts, and /dev/tty into ruleset.

requirements.title: Linux Landlock ABI v6 Scope Isolation for Abstract Sockets & Signals

developer_symptom.description: Agent connects to abstract unix sockets (@/tmp/dbus, @docker.sock) bypassing filesystem VFS rights or sends SIGKILL to host processes.
developer_symptom.impact: Cross-sandbox escape to host desktop daemons and host process killing.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Scope restriction with LANDLOCK_SCOPE_ABSTRACT_UNIX_SOCKET (1<<0) and LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL (1<<1).

requirements.title: Seccomp-BPF User Notification Observation Tap (Zero-TOCTOU)

developer_symptom.description: Using seccomp notif for enforcement causes TOCTOU memory racing or deadlocks the agent when supervisor thread is busy.
developer_symptom.impact: Agent freeze or TOCTOU security bypass.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Passive observation tap: supervisor validates ID before/after mem read and always responds with SECCOMP_USER_NOTIF_FLAG_CONTINUE, leaving access decisions strictly to Landlock LSM.

requirements.title: Seccomp ADDFD System File Emulation & /dev/null Injection

developer_symptom.description: Host-inspecting build tools fail when denied access to /etc/os-release or /proc/kallsyms; allowing raw access leaks host details.
developer_symptom.impact: Build pipeline breakdown on host-introspective scripts.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: ExactSystemFileSubstitution injecting /dev/null fd via SECCOMP_IOCTL_NOTIF_ADDFD for whitelisted paths while strictly rejecting execve/unlink/chmod.

requirements.title: Seccomp Syscall Hardening: Blocking 28 Escape Vectors

developer_symptom.description: Malicious code attempts unmounting secret masks (umount2), memory inspection (ptrace, process_vm_readv), io_uring LSM bypass, or eBPF injection.
developer_symptom.impact: Full sandbox breakout or kernel compromise.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: BPF filter blocking 28 escape syscalls with SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO(EPERM) and immediately killing x32 ABI invocations.

requirements.title: Unprivileged User Namespaces (CLONE_NEWUSER) & 2-Pipe Handshake

developer_symptom.description: Race condition during UID/GID mapping results in child running as nobody:nogroup (65534), breaking file creation and mount operations.
developer_symptom.impact: Sandbox initialization failure or broken workspace permissions.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Synchronized 2-pipe handshake (ready_fds child->parent, ack_fds parent->child) ensuring uid_map/gid_map is fully written before child executes.

requirements.title: Mount Namespace (CLONE_NEWNS) & 64MB /dev/shm and /tmp Isolation

developer_symptom.description: Parallel agents share /dev/shm and /tmp, snooping PyTorch tensors or exhausting host RAM; secret masks leak to host if not MS_PRIVATE.
developer_symptom.error_code: ENOSPC / Memory snoop / mount propagation leak
developer_symptom.impact: Cross-agent memory corruption and secret exposure.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Private mount namespace with dedicated 64MB tmpfs on /dev/shm and /tmp, bind-mount masking secrets with /dev/null, and 000 tmpfs for directories.

requirements.title: PID Namespace (CLONE_NEWPID) & Private /proc with hidepid=2

developer_symptom.description: Agent inspects /proc, discovering host processes, cmdline arguments, and environment variables containing API tokens of other agents.
developer_symptom.impact: Host process tree surveillance and API key theft.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: PID namespace isolation where supervisor acts as PID 1, mounting private procfs with hidepid=2, with graceful fallback to standard proc on older kernels.

requirements.title: Resource Ceilings & IPC Limits (setrlimit / cgroup v2)

developer_symptom.description: Fork-bomb, Node.js heap leaks, or unconstrained POSIX message queues crash the host developer machine.
developer_symptom.impact: Denial of service and developer workstation crash.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Enforcing equal hard and soft rlimits (rlim_cur == rlim_max) before execve, preventing child processes from elevating resource ceilings.

requirements.title: macOS Native Seatbelt SBPL Profiles (sandbox_init_with_parameters)

developer_symptom.description: Deprecated /usr/bin/sandbox-exec fails on macOS Sonoma/Sequoia; SBPL profiles without trailing deny allow ambient secret reading.
developer_symptom.error_code: sandbox_exec deprecation error / access granted to secrets
developer_symptom.impact: macOS sandbox failure or secret leakage.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: In-memory SBPL profile generation with parameterized ALLOW_* paths and trailing subtractive (deny file-read*) rules exploiting last-match-wins semantics.

requirements.title: macOS Endpoint Security (ES) Framework Synchronous AUTH Gates

developer_symptom.description: FSEvents is notify-only and cannot block malicious file writes; ES client without root or proper entitlement crashes, or AUTH delays cause kernel watchdog kills.
developer_symptom.impact: Inability to synchronously intercept filesystem events or agent process crash.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Synchronous AUTH event interceptor (EXEC, OPEN, RENAME, UNLINK) with strict capability gate (root + entitlement check) and honest fallback to Seatbelt.

requirements.title: Windows AppContainer Canonical DACL Injection & Profile Lifecycle

developer_symptom.description: Windows agent runs unconfined or DACL configuration fails with ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER due to non-canonical ACE order, exposing C:\Users\<User>\.ssh.
developer_symptom.impact: Windows filesystem isolation bypass or startup error.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Canonical DACL ordering (DENY ACE placed before GRANT ACE) with container inheritance and RAII AppContainerProfileGuard cleanup.

requirements.title: Windows Job Objects & Low-Integrity Restricted Tokens

developer_symptom.description: Agent spawns children with CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB or duplicates primary tokens, leaving zombie background processes after session termination.
developer_symptom.impact: Host resource hogging and unmonitored execution.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Job Object configured with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE (0x2000) and strict prohibition of BREAKAWAY_OK, coupled with Low-Integrity (SECURITY_MANDATORY_LOW_RID 0x1000) Restricted Token.

requirements.title: Go TLS Certificate Verification & Mach IPC trustd.agent Gate

developer_symptom.description: Go tools (go get, gh, golangci-lint) crash under macOS Seatbelt with 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' because Mach IPC to trustd.agent is blocked.
developer_symptom.error_code: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
developer_symptom.impact: Go toolchain completely inoperable under macOS sandbox.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Seatbelt Mach-lookup allowlist rule for trustd.agent and SecurityServer, combined with SSL_CERT_FILE environment fallback for fully air-gapped profiles.

requirements.title: Git over SSH (Port 22) Routing via Strict Proxy Brokers

developer_symptom.description: Git clone git@github.com:... hangs or fails with 'Connection refused' because OpenSSH cannot use HTTP CONNECT proxies directly.
developer_symptom.error_code: ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Connection refused
developer_symptom.impact: Inability to clone private git repositories over SSH.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Unix domain socket relay connecting git ssh client through strict host broker with opaque byte pumping for allowed host:22 endpoints.

requirements.title: Nested Subshell Execution ($(gh api ...)) & Recursion Barrier

developer_symptom.description: Complex bash scripts with command substitutions $(...) trigger cyclic sandbox re-initialization, causing process table exhaustion and freeze.
developer_symptom.impact: Subshell command execution failure and terminal deadlock.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Environment recursion barrier (VETTO_SANDBOXED=1, VETTO_SHIM_ACTIVE=1) causing CLI shims to bypass re-sandboxing and invoke host binaries directly.

requirements.title: PTY Stream Secret Redaction via Aho-Corasick Automaton (Zero-Overhead)

developer_symptom.description: Regex redaction on PTY stream adds 50-200ms lag per chunk, causing TUI stutter; changing string length with [REDACTED] corrupts ANSI cursor alignment.
developer_symptom.error_code: PTY latency lag / ANSI screen corruption
developer_symptom.impact: Degraded developer UX and corrupted terminal layout.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Zero-overhead Aho-Corasick DFA matching 23 token prefixes with 256-byte carry-over boundary buffer and PadMask length-preserving replacement.

requirements.title: Shannon Entropy Secret Filtering with False-Positive Suppression

developer_symptom.description: Crude entropy filters erroneously redact valid Git commit hashes (SHA-1/SHA-256), UUIDs, and base64 diffs, corrupting git diff output.
developer_symptom.error_code: False positive redaction in git logs / diffs
developer_symptom.impact: Unusable code diffs and diagnostic output.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Shannon entropy calculation (H > 4.5 bits/byte, len >= 20) with strict whitelist suppressing redaction for hex hashes (32, 40, 64 chars) and UUIDs.

requirements.title: IDE Statusline PTY Multiplexing & SIGWINCH Forwarding

developer_symptom.description: Running inside VS Code / Cursor integrated terminal causes broken statusline, lost terminal resize events, or corrupted IDE background tasks.
developer_symptom.impact: Broken IDE terminal integration.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Raw terminal multiplexer reserving exactly 1 bottom row for vetto statusline, dynamically forwarding SIGWINCH and hotkeys (Ctrl+] 0x1D).

requirements.title: Node.js npm / npx Cache Isolation & Lockfile Integrity

developer_symptom.description: npm install fails with EACCES on ~/.npm/_cacache or corrupts host user cache, leading to checksum mismatch in package-lock.json.
developer_symptom.impact: npm dependency installation failure or host cache corruption.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Environment variable redirection to $PROJECT/.vetto/cache/npm with Landlock read-write allowance while keeping /usr/local/lib/node_modules strictly read-only.

requirements.title: Rust Cargo Multi-Tenancy & Registry Index Lock Contention

developer_symptom.description: cargo build hangs with 'Blocking waiting for file lock on package cache' or fails to write ~/.cargo/registry due to lock contention.
developer_symptom.error_code: Blocking waiting for file lock on package cache
developer_symptom.impact: Cargo build freeze and lock contention across agents.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Read-only access to host cargo registry with isolated project target directory ($PROJECT/target) and private cargo cache overlay.

requirements.title: Python uv / pip / poetry Wheel Isolation & EXDEV Prevention

developer_symptom.description: uv, pip, or poetry crash with 'EXDEV: cross-device link not permitted' when attempting hardlinks from global cache into isolated tmpfs .venv.
developer_symptom.impact: Python package installation failure in virtual environments.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Injecting UV_LINK_MODE=copy and project-local PIP_CACHE_DIR to force atomic copying instead of cross-mount hardlinks.

requirements.title: pnpm Content-Addressable Store (CAS) & Mount Boundary Handling

developer_symptom.description: pnpm install crashes with EXDEV when hardlinking from global store across mount namespaces.
developer_symptom.impact: pnpm package installation abort.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Enabling LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER (ABI >= 2) and configuring package-import-method=copy or project-local pnpm store-dir.

requirements.title: Bun SQLite WAL Cache Isolation & Install Dir Lock Contention

developer_symptom.description: bun install or bun test fails with 'error: FailedToLockInstallDir' or 'database is locked' due to WAL contention in ~/.bun/install/cache.
developer_symptom.impact: Bun package installation freeze and test abort.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Redirecting BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR to $PROJECT/.vetto/cache/bun with private tmpfs for temporary socket endpoints.

requirements.title: DebugPortGuard: Blocking Loopback Debugging (9222, 9229, 5678)

developer_symptom.description: Agent executes script connecting to host Chrome DevTools (9222) or Node Inspector (9229), hijacking developer browser sessions and cookies.
developer_symptom.impact: Developer browser session hijacking and corporate credential theft.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Interception of loopback connections to ports 9222, 9223, 9229, 9230, 5678, returning DebugPortVerdict::Blocked unless authorized by cryptographic session token.

assertions: assert_eq!(guard.check_access(9222, None), DebugPortVerdict::Blocked { port: 9222, service: "Chrome DevTools" })
assert_eq!(guard.check_access(9229, None), DebugPortVerdict::Blocked { port: 9229, service: "Node.js Inspector" })
assert_eq!(guard.check_access(5678, None), DebugPortVerdict::Blocked { port: 5678, service: "Python debugpy" })

requirements.title: DNS Rebinding Pinning & Cloud Metadata CIDR Blacklist

developer_symptom.description: Malicious package performs DNS rebinding, resolving domain to 169.254.169.254 to steal cloud IAM instance metadata tokens.
developer_symptom.impact: Cloud infrastructure compromise and IAM credential exfiltration.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Single external DNS resolution with strict CIDR validation (blocking link-local, loopback, private ranges) and TCP session IP pinning.

requirements.title: Linux FS-ONLY Process Death Signal (PR_SET_PDEATHSIG) & Subtree Cleanup

developer_symptom.description: In FS-ONLY environments without namespaces, supervisor crash leaves orphaned compilers and background test processes consuming host CPU.
developer_symptom.impact: Host system slowdown and unreleased file locks.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Child process calls PR_SET_PDEATHSIG with SIGKILL before execve, checks parent liveness race (getppid() != expected), and isolates process group.

requirements.title: Cross-Architecture Syscall Translation (x86_64 vs aarch64 / ARM64)

developer_symptom.description: Hardcoded x86_64 syscall numbers in BPF filter running on Apple Silicon / ARM64 disable security gates or crash with SIGSYS.
developer_symptom.error_code: SIGSYS (Bad system call) / BPF filter bypass
developer_symptom.impact: Instant agent crash or total security bypass on ARM64.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Target-specific syscall mapping via libc constants and first-instruction audit architecture validation (AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64 vs AUDIT_ARCH_AARCH64) killing foreign archs.

requirements.title: OFD Advisory Lock Abandonment & Zombie Concurrency Collision

developer_symptom.description: Killed agent leaves .vetto_repair.lock, blocking future agent runs with 'already has an active writer on session transcript (-32600)'.
developer_symptom.impact: Permanent session lock deadlock requiring manual file deletion.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: OFD advisory locking with JSON lock metadata, PID liveness probing (kill(pid, 0) == ESRCH), lease expiration reclaim, and RAII SessionLockGuard drop.

requirements.title: Cross-VFS SQLite WAL Timeout & SHM Memory Mapping Deadlocks (9P /mnt/c)

developer_symptom.description: Running Codex/Cursor under WSL2 with Windows mounts (/mnt/c) causes 60s SQLite freezes and 'database disk image is malformed (11)' due to 9P mmap incoherence.
developer_symptom.impact: Unrecoverable SQLite database corruption and session lockup.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: SqliteWalManager staging engine: copies DB and sidecars (-wal, -shm, -journal) to local tmpfs, checkpoints WAL with TRUNCATE, runs integrity_check, and verifies.

requirements.title: Subagent Fork History Explosion & Base64 Blob Duplication

developer_symptom.description: Subagent branching duplicates multimodal base64 screenshots into child transcripts, exploding ~/.claude/projects to 50-150 GB and triggering Node.js OOM.
developer_symptom.error_code: FATAL ERROR: JavaScript heap out of memory / Budget exceeded
developer_symptom.impact: Disk space exhaustion and agent heap crash.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Strict inspection budgets (512MB session ceiling, 2GB total pool), safe bounded reading with symlink rejection, and hash stability validation.

requirements.title: Corrupted JSONL Stream Tail Compaction & Incomplete Token Truncation

developer_symptom.description: Process interruption (SIGKILL, Ctrl+C) leaves half-written JSONL record; subsequent resume fails with 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input'.
developer_symptom.error_code: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input / EOF while parsing string
developer_symptom.impact: Corrupted session transcript unreadable by CLI resume.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Streaming transcript repair: parses records, truncates incomplete tail record, quarantines malformed lines, repairs byte-0 corruptions, and ensures terminal marker.

requirements.title: Non-Monotonic Ordinal Desynchronization & Turn Sequence Regressions

developer_symptom.description: Resuming session produces duplicate/regressed step numbers (ordinal 6 followed by 6 or 4), causing UI state freeze or infinite tool call loops.
developer_symptom.error_code: Error: Resumed session sequence regression / state projection freeze
developer_symptom.impact: Agent hangs in infinite execution loop.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Monotonic re-sequencing engine: tracks duplicate and regressed ordinals, re-indexes steps sequentially (0..N), deduplicates boundary items, and updates SQLite index.

requirements.title: Cursor Workspace State SQLite (state.vscdb) & ItemTable JSON Bloat Repair

developer_symptom.description: Cursor crash corrupts state.vscdb; composer.composerData contains truncated JSON, wiping active Composer chat history on next launch.
developer_symptom.error_code: [Error] Unable to restore Composer session: JSON.parse error in state.vscdb
developer_symptom.impact: Total loss of multi-file Composer conversation and active context.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Selective ItemTable repair: balances unclosed quotes/brackets in JSON values while strictly skipping sensitive credential keys, followed by WAL checkpoint.

requirements.title: Subagent Tree Orphanage & Parent PID Disconnect State Fragmentation

developer_symptom.description: Parent CLI process crash orphans background subagents, which re-parent to init (PID 1) and continue writing to disk and holding port 3000.
developer_symptom.error_code: Orphaned subagent process tree / EADDRINUSE on port 3000
developer_symptom.impact: Port locking and silent workspace corruption by zombie subagents.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: PID namespace encapsulation where init reaper terminates subagents upon supervisor exit, combined with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG in all spawned children.

requirements.title: Cross-Session State Bleed & Shared Global Storage Poisoning

developer_symptom.description: Concurrent agents in different projects overwrite ~/.claude.json or global state.vscdb, leaking closed project paths into public reports.
developer_symptom.impact: Privacy breach and session state collision across repos.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Atomic project reconciliation updating only knownProjects in ~/.claude.json, skipping symlinks and strictly ignoring auth/token credential paths.

requirements.title: Stale SQLite Index Pointer Desynchronization & Ghost Sessions

developer_symptom.description: Codex SQLite index references deleted session JSONL files; rescue scan crashes with 'session selector is ambiguous or points to missing inode'.
developer_symptom.error_code: ENOENT / missing inode / session selector ambiguous
developer_symptom.impact: Rescue and resume tool crash on deleted files.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Dual-mode scanner: index-first validates file presence with safe_fs before yielding, while filesystem-all walks disk ignoring corrupt SQLite indexes.

requirements.title: Non-Atomic State Rollback & Partial Repair Race Conditions

developer_symptom.description: Power failure or SIGKILL during session repair truncates original transcript with zero backup, permanently losing conversation history.
developer_symptom.error_code: Partial file write corruption / lost session
developer_symptom.impact: Irreversible loss of agent conversation data.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Two-phase repair: creates pre-repair backup in .vetto_backups/<timestamp>/ with original SHA-256, writes to temp file + fsync + atomic rename, with rollback verification.

requirements.title: 7-Tier Policy Precedence & Deterministic Layer Inheritance

developer_symptom.description: Local .vetto.override.toml or CLI flags unpredictably override corporate security policies, creating security holes or build breakage.
developer_symptom.error_code: Policy precedence conflict / security policy bypass
developer_symptom.impact: Unpredictable security enforcement and accidental exposure.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Deterministic 7-tier precedence (SystemGlobal -> UserGlobal -> BuiltinProfile -> AgentPreset -> Repository -> LocalOverride -> CLI), accumulating allows, strictly enforcing denies.

requirements.title: Enterprise Policy Lockdown & Immutable Security Directives

developer_symptom.description: Developer repository includes allow_write = ['/etc'] in repo config, disabling sandbox isolation in enterprise CI/CD runners.
developer_symptom.impact: Unauthorized sandbox escape in enterprise environments.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: When [security] immutable = true is set in Tier 1, any attempt in Tier 2-7 to widen permissions, relax limits, or override denies immediately halts execution before spawn.

requirements.title: Subtractive Deny Rules over Positive Landlock Allowlists

developer_symptom.description: Allowing project directory $PROJECT in Landlock automatically exposes .env, .git, and private keys within project root.
developer_symptom.impact: Exposure of in-tree project secrets.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: In Tier FULL: bind-mounts /dev/null over denied files and mode 000 tmpfs over denied dirs. In Tier FS-ONLY: bounded enumeration building explicit allow sub-paths.

requirements.title: Cryptographic Audit Trail with SHA-256 HMAC Chained Logging

developer_symptom.description: Compromised script deletes or tampers with lines in local audit log (vetto.jsonl) to hide unauthorized network connections.
developer_symptom.error_code: HMAC verification failure at line N
developer_symptom.impact: Undetected audit trail manipulation.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Append-only regular file sink rejecting symlinks, where every event contains an HMAC-SHA256 signature chained with the previous line hash.

requirements.title: Enterprise CI/CD Pipeline Telemetry & SARIF 2.1.0 Vulnerability Reporting

developer_symptom.description: Blocked sandbox access attempts in CI/CD are lost in console text output, failing to alert GitHub/GitLab Security Dashboards.
developer_symptom.error_code: Missing SARIF telemetry in CI/CD dashboard
developer_symptom.impact: Silent security policy violations in CI pipelines.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Generation of OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 JSON reports containing physical artifact locations, process metadata, and categorized rule violations.

requirements.title: Regulatory Zero-Daemon, Zero-Background-Process & Ephemeral Lifecycle

developer_symptom.description: Docker/Podman daemon requirements violate enterprise zero-daemon compliance policies and leave orphaned root containers.
developer_symptom.error_code: Daemon socket vulnerability / Compliance audit failure
developer_symptom.impact: Rejection by enterprise banking and defense security auditors.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Complete elimination of background daemons and sockets: single binary invocation executes single session and cleans up 100% of process tree.

requirements.title: Regulatory Zero-Telemetry & Offline Air-Gapped Compliance

developer_symptom.description: Third-party sandbox tools leak telemetry or code snippets to analytics backends (PostHog, Sentry, Segment) in air-gapped secure networks.
developer_symptom.error_code: Unauthorized network egress in air-gapped network
developer_symptom.impact: Proprietary code leak and regulatory compliance breach.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Strict zero-telemetry in binary (zero analytics crates), network='off' creating unconfigured CLONE_NEWNET, and local-only report generation.

requirements.title: Dynamic Context-Aware Policy Evaluation & Conditional Budgets

developer_symptom.description: Unbounded conditions (e.g. project_contains on deep trees) cause policy loader to hang or crash on large monorepos.
developer_symptom.error_code: Condition scan timeout / Fail-closed rule rejection
developer_symptom.impact: Sandbox startup freeze on large monorepos.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Context evaluator for branch and file conditions with strict budgets (depth 4, 1000 files, 1MB), failing closed upon limit overflow.

requirements.title: Multi-Agent Isolation Sandboxing & Inter-Agent Lateral Movement Prevention

developer_symptom.description: Compromised PR worker agent accesses shared /dev/shm or probes localhost to attack production deployment agent on same machine.
developer_symptom.error_code: EPERM on ptrace / abstract socket denied
developer_symptom.impact: Lateral compromise across parallel agent workers.

syscalls_or_apis: seccomp block ptrace, process_vm_readv, abstract unix sockets
kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: Individual IPC/Network namespaces per agent, private 64MB /dev/shm, and seccomp blocking of ptrace, process_vm_readv, and abstract sockets.

requirements.title: High-Entropy Secret Redaction & Multi-Stage Token Scrubbing Pipeline

developer_symptom.description: Agent prints private SSH keys, AWS AKIA keys, or GitHub tokens into stdout/reports, leaking credentials to CI/CD logs.
developer_symptom.error_code: Secret leak in CI/CD log export
developer_symptom.impact: Corporate credential leak to external log aggregators.

kernel_mechanisms.defense_architecture: 5-stage scrubbing pipeline redacting PEM headers, prefixed tokens (AWS, GitHub, Slack, OpenAI), Bearer auth, env vars, and high-entropy strings without corrupting UTF-8.
